about: Experience Dino Crisis originally released on the PlayStation® console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

A covert mission to investigate an isolated research facility goes awry when a world-renowned scientist is found alive three years after his reported death. Shockingly, he's not the only thing back from the grave. Experience the thrill of survival against prehistoric threats in this horror classic!

This title has been converted from the PlayStation® version to the PlayStation®4 and PlayStation®5 consoles and provides newly added features. Consequently, there may be times where the title plays differently from the PlayStation® version, or where some features may cause the title to not function properly. This version does not support the PlayStation® console’s peripherals, therefore some functionality may not be available.
summary: Experience Dino Crisis originally released on the PlayStation® console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
